However, it failed with a TypeError due to an incorrect join operation in the `_get_join_info()` method of the Merge class. The error occurred because `self._left_indexer(sv, ov)` was called without considering the correct indexers for left and right dataframes.

- pandas.core.reshape.merge.Merge._get_join_info
- pandas.core.indexes.base.Index._left_indexer
